# SmallDocs

SmallDocs is a Markdown reader and editor, a command line tool for opening local files and creating share links, and a hosted workspace for documents you choose to store in SmallDocs Cloud.

## Use SmallDocs locally

- [Install the CLI](https://smalldocs.org/install)
- [Product documentation](https://smalldocs.org/docs)
- [Standard SmallDocs agent skill](https://smalldocs.org/agent-skills/standard/.well-known/agent-skills/smalldocs/SKILL.md)
- [Standard skill catalog](https://smalldocs.org/agent-skills/standard/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json)

## Use SmallDocs Cloud

- [Cloud overview, setup, and pricing](https://smalldocs.org/cloud)
- [Cloud-aware SmallDocs agent skill](https://smalldocs.org/agent-skills/cloud/.well-known/agent-skills/smalldocs/SKILL.md)
- [Cloud skill catalog](https://smalldocs.org/agent-skills/cloud/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json)

## Document formats

- [Markdown](https://smalldocs.org/developers/authoring/markdown.md)
- [Code](https://smalldocs.org/developers/authoring/code.md)
- [Math](https://smalldocs.org/developers/authoring/math.md)
- [Diagrams](https://smalldocs.org/developers/authoring/diagrams.md)
- [Charts](https://smalldocs.org/developers/authoring/charts.md)
- [Spreadsheets](https://smalldocs.org/developers/authoring/cells.md)
- [Slides](https://smalldocs.org/developers/authoring/slides.md)
- [Custom slide shapes](https://smalldocs.org/developers/authoring/slide-shapes.md)
- [Interactive tools](https://smalldocs.org/developers/authoring/apps.md)
- [Walkthroughs](https://smalldocs.org/developers/authoring/walkthroughs.md)
- [Video](https://smalldocs.org/developers/authoring/video.md)
- [Styles](https://smalldocs.org/developers/authoring/styles.md)
